description_en: Step up an extra half block per level.
description_zh: 每级增加半格自动跨越高度。

description_en: Experience-dropping blocks yield +1 XP per level; incompatible with Silk Touch.
description_zh: 采集原本掉落经验的方块时，每级额外获得1经验；与精准采集互斥。

description_en: Grants night vision while submerged; lingers for 12 seconds.
description_zh: 潜入水下时获得夜视，离水后最多保留12秒。

description_en: At 18+ food, heals 1 health per level every 10 seconds, adding exhaustion.
description_zh: 饥饿值至少18时，每10秒恢复每级1点生命，并增加消耗度。

description_en: While holding a tool, extends block and entity interaction reach by 0.5 per level.
description_zh: 持工具时，每级增加0.5格方块与实体交互距离。

description_en: While actively blocking, grants Resistance I/II; lingers for 2 seconds.
description_zh: 持续举盾格挡时获得抗性提升I/II，放下后最多保留2秒。

description_en: Projectile hits levitate the victim for 1/2 seconds.
description_zh: 远程命中令目标漂浮1/2秒。

description_en: Survives one fatal hit with 6 health and brief absorption. 20-minute world-time cooldown; damages armor by 32. Void/admin damage excluded.
description_zh: 致命伤害时保留6生命并获得短暂伤害吸收；世界时间20分钟冷却，消耗32护甲耐久。虚空及管理伤害除外。

description_en: Walking steps do not emit vibrations. Sprinting and other actions still do.
description_zh: 正常行走不发出脚步振动；疾跑及其他活动不受影响。

description_en: Melee transfers up to 5/10 seconds of your fire and extinguishes you. Fire-immune targets cannot take it.
description_zh: 近战命中时转移自身最多5/10秒燃烧并熄灭自己；免疫火焰的目标不接受转移。

description_en: Normal arrows may be spared when loading. Spared shots cannot be recovered.
description_zh: 装填普通箭时可能不消耗弹药；未消耗的箭射出后不可拾回。

description_en: Full draw takes 18/16/14 ticks. Maximum shot power is unchanged.
description_zh: 完整蓄力缩短至18/16/14游戏刻，满蓄力威力不变。

description_en: Hold sneak in midair to brake and steer horizontally. Does not slow your fall.
description_zh: 空中按住潜行可水平减速与微调落点，不减缓下落。

description_en: Raise the shield just before a frontal arrow hits to reflect it along your view.
description_zh: 在正面箭矢命中前精准举盾，将原箭朝视线方向反弹。

description_en: Thrown impacts create a brief, gentle pulling vortex.
description_zh: 投掷命中后形成短暂、平缓牵引附近生物的漩涡。

description_en: Underwater, sense a few nearby chests and barrels through faint outlines.
description_zh: 水下以微弱轮廓感知近处少量箱子与木桶。

description_en: Running off a ledge briefly forms up to three personal footholds. 20-second cooldown.
description_zh: 跑离地面边缘时短暂形成最多3格个人落脚点，冷却20秒。
